as_told.title: JAL 1628 followed by a giant craft over Alaska

plain: In 1986 over Alaska, a Japan Airlines pilot is said to have flown for 45 minutes alongside something unknown, and the White House is said to have taken the radar records, which Michels says are now public and have been studied by physicists. He brings it up on his own on one episode, and on another credits the researcher Kevin Knuth and the skeptic Michael Shermer with raising it. Knuth, telling it without naming a source, gives the details: it was JAL 1628, a Japan Airlines cargo flight flown by Captain Kenju Teruchi, who met a giant craft. Knuth says nothing of the 45 minutes or the White House taking the radar, and if the case holds up it would be a long airline sighting with radar data behind it.
